scope: sampled-only final sixth-package still review: eight regenerated day/night bookmarks, four Fisher route details, two Lily Pool details and one documentation hero; not every animation frame

images.observation: Open pavilion axis remains clear. Interlocking timber ribs, pale caps, deck shadows and surrounding planting are readable. The former upright Fisher approach slab is absent from the left background.

Mature canopies and historic brick houses frame the clear pedestrian path and seasonal arches. Canopy poles remain closed; lobed and faceted foliage and polygonal path edges remain visible stylizations.
Glasshouse roof framing, visible palms, foreground fountain and framing tree crowns remain readable. No new foreground obstruction or canopy-pole sliver is observed.
The aerial shows wooded zoo grounds and readable roads/paths. Trees are outside the visible foreground vehicle carriageway; no new overlap is observed.
Warm practical lights reveal the pavilion ribs and deck, with reflections in the foreground. Fine stochastic grain remains visible on timber and ground; the open route remains readable.

Distinct blue, purple, green, orange and yellow seasonal lights form a readable procession along the path. Warm windows remain visible. Grain and bright samples remain on the ground and in some lit foliage.

Actual glasshouse framing, interior palms and reflected planting are visible under broad practical illumination. The garden/fountain rim is readable, but large areas remain dark and the image retains visible stochastic grain.
Selective building entries, Conservatory lights and colored mall accents identify the zoo within the city. Most park ground is dark; this frame does not establish detailed route readability at night.

The near Fisher approach is now a broad, shallow graded deck descending from the bridge. The former tall slab is gone, revealing the Café Brauer massing behind it. Bridge piers and surrounding planting remain readable.

The lower timber boardwalk and rails lead toward the bridge; both sloped approaches are visible across the pond. The center span remains above the lower path, with no former wall obstructing the view.

The approach reads as a low diagonal silhouette, with the illuminated Café Brauer and selected tree lighting visible behind it. The foreground and bridge itself are very dark; this is limited silhouette confirmation, not full nighttime deck-detail validation.

Café Brauer remains visible across the pond instead of being screened by a tall approach slab. Lower boardwalk rails, water and bridge are mostly dark silhouettes; daylight details provide the stronger geometry evidence.
The Lily Pool extends across the middle of the image, with twin low pavilions and Conservatory behind. The near-bank path remains clear. Surrounding planting and skyline are visible.

Lit Conservatory framing and selected tree accents remain visible, with small reflections. The pool-edge path and twin pavilions are very dark; the image does not support a claim of strong night readability for the pool itself.

The larger hero clearly shows distinct colored arch lamps, decorative tree strings, warm windows and their ground reflections. Tree crowns frame the route. Fine ground speckles remain visible; no caption or attribution overlay is present in this still.

findings.fisherApproaches: Accepted: day route3 at 60 and 90 seconds shows horizontal-width sloping decks, the former upright walls are absent, and Café Brauer sightlines are restored. Night samples show the corrected low silhouette but have limited deck-detail readability. Component tests separately establish dimensions, grade and support; no numerical geometry claim is inferred solely from images.
findings.canopyAndRoads: Previously corrected canopy poles remain closed in the sampled close views, and trees clear the visible foreground roadway in the day aerial. Foliage remains visibly procedural and faceted.
findings.nightLighting: Pavilion, mall seasonal lights and Conservatory are readable. Pond-side paths, Fisher Bridge and Lily Pool remain quite dark outside selected accent lights.

historicalReview.note: Pre-ramp visual record preserved without modification; it did not include the later route samples that exposed the ramp orientation bug.

limits: Only the fifteen listed PNGs were actually viewed. This does not certify every route frame, camera angle or movie.
Static images cannot establish temporal stability, absence of ghosting, full collision clearance or live frame rate.
Visible stochastic grain and small bright ground samples remain in several night stills, including the documentation hero.
The architecture, procedural vegetation, relative elevations and seasonal installation are documented interpretations rather than surveyed replicas or a current exact ZooLights display.
Several polygonal path edges and visibly segmented/faceted landscape forms remain part of the current model fidelity.
